description: This file declares functions and structures related to handling diff formats of merge commits in a version control system. It provides an interface for configuring diff options, parsing command-line arguments, and setting various display modes related to merge diffs.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merging options based on a string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppresses parsing of certain diff merge options.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to diff merges.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merge output for given revision info.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets default diff mode to show only the first parent of merge commits.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Sets default diff mode to dense combined format.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets dense combined diff mode if it hasn't been set.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Prepares revision information for diff display related to merges.
